name: rosetta-blum-integer
code:
use default

let limit = 8_900_000
let smallest_factor = LIST(limit + 1)

for _ in 0::limit do
    smallest_factor.add(0)
od

for candidate in 2::limit do
    if smallest_factor[candidate] == 0 then
        let multiple mut = candidate

        while multiple <= limit do
            if smallest_factor[multiple] == 0 then
                smallest_factor[multiple] = candidate
            fi
            multiple = multiple + candidate
        od
    fi
od

is_blum(value: int) -> bool is
    let p = smallest_factor[value]
    let q = value / p

    return p != q /\ p % 4 == 3 /\ q % 4 == 3 /\ smallest_factor[q] == q
si

let blum = (2::limit) |> filter(is_blum) |> take(400_000) |> collect_list()

write_line("the first 50 Blum integers:")

for row in 0..5 do
    let cells = (0..10) |> map(column => "{blum[row * 10 + column],4}")

    write_line(cells |> join(""))
od

write_line("")

for position in [26_828, 100_000, 200_000, 300_000, 400_000] do
    write_line("the {position,7}th Blum integer: {blum[position - 1]}")
od

write_line("")
write_line("distribution of the final digit over the first 400,000:")

for digit in [1, 3, 7, 9] do
    let share = cast double(blum |> filter(b => b % 10 == digit) |> count())

    write_line("  {digit}: {share / 4000.0D:F3}%")
od
